inputs.text:
Look closely at what they are trying to hide from us. The mainstream narrative wants you to believe it was just a spontaneous "No Kings" rally that got out of hand, but anyone with their eyes open can see the invisible strings being pulled by the elite coordinators behind the scenes. They deliberately engineered this chaos to justify the deployment of federal officers with tear gas. 

It is all part of a synchronized script. They orchestrate the clashes, stage the resistance, and then use the resulting volatility to condition the public into accepting total control and obedience. And conveniently, they are only admitting to at least 13 arrests across places like Portland, Denver and... to downplay the true scale of their coordinated crackdown. They create the disorder themselves, then blame the crowds to push their hidden agenda. Do not buy the official lie.
